messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SLO breach detected
model=int8-calib-v3 region=us-west-2 metric=p99_latency_streaming value=3120ms (SLO=1200ms)
thread_ts=5765432100

sara_onsite: paging @miguel_oncall — seeing a big tail spike across streaming nodes, multiple pools. p95 and p99 jumping. oncall?

miguel_oncall: on it. joining metrics now. any recent deploys or auto-calib rollouts in the past hour?

ash_dev: I rolled the int8 calibration bundle (int8-calib-v3) about 25m ago (deploy ts ~5765428000). changed qkv dequant kernel selection and enabled auto_recalib=true for faster post-merge.

evan_sre: grabbing traces. p95 baseline ~180ms -> now ~620ms, p99 from ~480ms -> 3120ms. Streaming stalls reported (clients see long gaps >1s between chunks). KV cache miss rate jumped x6 concurrently.

jess_support: CS reports two enterprise customers hitting errors: one saw truncated streams (no EOS), one saw repeated partial responses. Nicoya (nicoya_support) opened a ticket with logs.

miguel_oncall: immediate triage plan: 1) throttle/disable int8-calib-v3 routing 2) enable fp16 fallback for premium/enterprise 3) scale up us-west inference pool by +2 nodes 4) investigate KV cache invalidation. executing now.

ops_bot: executing route change: set weight(int8-calib-v3)=0 -> removed from active rotation at 5765432145. ramp fp16-fallback +15% for all traffic. Scale request submitted to infra: +2 g4dn nodes to us-west pool.

sara_onsite: confirm KV cache warm status — I see a clear restart of cache shards around 5765428200 correlating with the calibration job completion. cold misses spiking.

ash_dev: ugh — the calibration step rewrote shard mappings for KV cache during transform, which invalidated existing hotspots. auto_recalib=true caused a full remap. reverting auto_recalib immediately.

miguel_oncall: starting rollback of int8-calib-v3 -> int8-calib-v2 (last known good). rolling out with shotgun=serial across 6 pools. ETA ~8m.

ops_bot: rollback job started at 5765432160. routing now favoring fp16 and stable int8-v2 in parallel.

evan_sre: sample trace (irrelevant fields redacted):
```
TRACEID: 0a3f... | model=int8-calib-v3 | step=decode | wall_ms=1100
TRACEID: 0a3f... | step=kvcache_lookup | hit=false | backend_ms=420
TRACEID: 0a3f... | step=kernel_dequant | stall_ms=650 | note="wait on dequant queue"
```
These stalls line up with high KV miss + longer kernel dequant path after the new calibration kernels enabled.

paul_eng: adding that some microbenchmarks for the new kernel show tail jitter at long sequence lengths — may be a scheduling effect when cache misses push more work into dequant path.

ops_bot: rollback completed at 5765432200. routing sanity check: p99 now 980ms, p95 210ms. observed streaming gap rate down ~85%.

jess_support: notified Nicoya (nicoya_support) at 5765432230; CS ticket updated with mitigation notes. they acknowledged, will monitor. No confirmed data loss; some responses were truncated while mitigation in flight.

evan_sre: snapshot graphs uploaded to /incidents/5765432100/graphs.png (internal). immediate follow-ups: add guard to prevent full KV shard remap during calibration, and add a canary step for calibration rollouts limited to 1% traffic for 30m.

miguel_oncall: handing off to @evan_sre for postmortem and long-term fixes — I am back on rotation.

sara_onsite: action items captured:
- ash_dev: PR to disable auto_recalib by default and add explicit remap-safe flag (owner: ash_dev; ETA 48h)
- evan_sre: add canary rollout + tail-p99 regression checks to rollout job (owner: evan_sre; ETA 72h)
- ops: add runbook step to throttle calibration jobs when KV miss rate >3x baseline (owner: paul_eng; ETA 72h)
- support: follow up with Nicoya and runthrough of incident timeline (owner: jess_support; ETA 24h)

ash_dev: will open PR today to change the rollout config and include an automated kvcache-stability check that blocks remap if active sessions > threshold.

nicoya_support: thanks for the quick mitigation — we'll keep monitoring and will update the ticket if anything else.

evan_sre: post-incident notes: include p95/p99 streaming tests in CI for calibration bundles, add rollout throttles, and ensure kernel toggles have tail-regression guards. scheduling postmortem sync tomorrow 10:00 PT.

miguel_oncall: marking incident resolved for immediate customer impact. creating incident record and tagging sev-incidents.

sara_onsite: closing loop here — good job all. will follow up on the documented action items. :thumbsup:
